liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): The performance is described as monstrous, highlighting the band's exceptional strength during this era; The performance features great drumming, contributing to the show's spunky quality for the year [4][6]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): The song is characterized as out of this world, with a memorable bathroom conversation following it; The reviewer called a friend immediately after, declaring it the Stella Blue of the decade [4][12]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): The opening song is described as incredible, with volume and energy that just blows you away [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **It's All Over Now, Baby Blue**: back after 128 archived shows (556 days) [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-09-17.sbd.miller.119979.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd94-09-17.sbd.ladner.10068.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 3.71/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Jerry's voice had a different slack, though the music was always present for those who listened closely; Jerry sings strong, gets lyrics right, and glides through solos without the uninspired playing common in 1994 [9][10]
- **gd1994-09-17.nak300.bowen.109983.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 162 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- The reviewer attended during their senior year at UC Santa Cruz, viewing it as a culmination of their experience [9]
- The reviewer ran in to catch the start, parking on a dirt road to avoid paying a ticket [13]
- The reviewer arrived late without a ticket but was given one by someone dancing by the gate [14]
- Fall 1994 is noted as a period where the band had their act together, resulting in good shows [7]
- The performance quality is compared more to 1991 than to the typical 1994 shows [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-09-17.sbd.miller.119979.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) [1]
- **gd94-09-17.sbd.ladner.10068.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>C>DAT>CDR [3]
- **gd1994-09-17.nak300.bowen.109983.flac16**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Brad Foster; source: Source: (OTS) Nakamichi CM-300's/CP-1 > Sony TCD-D10; [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - September 17, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/september-17-1994) [17]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - September 17, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/september-17-1994) [18]
